title: Northgate+ Annual Cancellation Refund: Prorated Fee and Cash Recovery
content:
**Clause.** On an immediate cancellation of a Northgate+ Annual membership of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships handled by the annual cancellation schedule, the refund refers to the most recent settled annual fee charge on the membership. When the membership carries no settled annual fee charge, nothing is refunded.

The refund is the refund core less the Cash recovery, never more than that fee and never below zero, rounded down to the cent. When the refund comes to zero, the cancellation is still recorded and confirmed, and no refund entry is booked.

- **Refund core.** The prorated fee: the fee multiplied by the whole calendar months from the cancellation date to the renewal date, divided by the tier's paid term in months. A whole calendar month is counted when the renewal date reaches the same day of the month as the cancellation date.
- **Cash recovery.** The member-bonus Northgate Cash of the twelve whole calendar months before the cancellation date, never below zero and rounded half up to the cent. The member-bonus Cash is the net Cash minus the base-rate Cash. The net Cash is the Cash earned in that period minus the Cash reversed in that period. The base-rate Cash is the tier's Northgate Cash earn rate, as a percentage, of the net basis. The net basis is the earning bases of that period minus the reversal bases of that period.

The period covers the Northgate Cash earnings and reversals on the membership's ledger dated on a day from which fewer than twelve whole calendar months have passed by the cancellation date. An earning's basis is the earning basis recorded on it; a reversal's basis is the refunded merchandise recorded on it.

**Order of the steps.** The Cash recovery is rounded half up to the cent on its own; the refund core less the Cash recovery is then capped at the fee, rounded down to the cent, and set to zero if below zero.

**Worked example (hypothetical figures chosen for round arithmetic; fee 120.00 on a 12-month term, earn rate 1 percent)**

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| whole calendar months from the cancellation date to the renewal date | 7 |
| refund core | 120.00 multiplied by 7, divided by 12, that is 70.00 |
| Cash earned in the period, and its earning bases | 9.00 on 600.00 |
| Cash reversed in the period, and its reversal bases | 1.00 on 50.00 |
| net Cash | 9.00 less 1.00, that is 8.00 |
| net basis | 600.00 less 50.00, that is 550.00 |
| base-rate Cash | 1 percent of 550.00, that is 5.50 |
| Cash recovery | 8.00 less 5.50, that is 2.50 |
| refund | 70.00 less 2.50, that is 67.50 |

If the net Cash were below the base-rate Cash, the Cash recovery would be zero and the refund would equal the refund core.
